disposition.ask: county market data for buyer-intent scoring on a parcel
disposition.reason: County-level employment (BLS QCEW) is available, but 'market data' is typically broader (demographics, income, commercial activity, absorption rates, competitive density). Employment alone may not be sufficient for retail buyer-intent scoring without clarification of what 'market data' includes.
disposition.description: BLS QCEW annual-average covered employment (all ownerships, all industries) for the containing county, latest year.
disposition.interpretation_hints: BLS QCEW annual-average **covered** employment (place-of-work), latest year (2025). Honesty; covered (UI) employment excludes self-employed, most agriculture, and military - it is NOT the total labor force.

disposition.ask: parcel data for the matched parcel
disposition.reason: parcel_id is available but is an identifier only. A buyer-intent scoring decision likely needs multiple parcel attributes (size, zoning, owner, location geometry). The request groups these as 'parcel data' but no single field answers 'all parcel data' — multiple fields (parcel_id, parcel_area_m2, parcel_zoning, parcel_geometry_wkt, parcel_owner, parcel_apn) are available as distinct matches.
disposition.description: Stable Regrid identifier for the matched parcel.
disposition.interpretation_hints: Ownership/identity reflect the Regrid source vintage, which can predate a recent sale — verify recent transactions (a parcel may still list a prior owner after acquisition). parcel_data_source tells you the tier; premium fields are null on regrid_free_tier (data-tier limited, NOT 'no parcel here').
